To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the application of foliar spray of NPK 19 : 19 :19 0. 5%, KNO3 1% and KNO3 2% significantly enhanced the dry matter production and dry matter partitioning in groundnut under drought conditions.

foliar application of chemical fertilizer (NPK 19: 19: 1.5%) at 75 and KNO3 2.5% at podding stage (60 DAS) was found to be the best treatment for mitigating the adverse effects of drought stress on groundnut crop.

the foliar spray of NPK 19.19.19 0.05% and KNO3 1% at 60 DAS (15 days after imposition of drought stress) significantly enhanced dry matter production and partitioning in different plant parts and yield attributes of Groundnut crop.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of drought and foliar nutrition in Groundnut crop, which is a major crop in the dryland region of the world.
the effects of drought stress and chemical nutrient foliar application on growth and yield of groundnut.
the effects of drought and foliar application of chemical nutrient on dry matter production and allocation in groundnut.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the foliar spray of KNO3 1% and NPK 19 : 19:19 1% was found to be effective in increasing the dry matter accumulation in groundnut crop and also found to improve the yield attributes and yield of groundnut under drought stress condition.
foliar spray of KNO3 1% was found to be effective in improving the yield and yield attributing traits in groundnut under moisture stress.

foliar spray of NPK 19-19-19 0.25% and KNO3 2% at 75 days and NPK 19 19:19 1.0% and KCl at 90 days after sowing was found to be more effective to alleviate drought stress by improving the growth and yield of groundnut.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the application of NPK 19.19.19 0.05% and KNO3 1.5% at the pod formation to pod filling stages could be recommended to enhance the dry matter production in groundnut under drought stress condition.
the foliar spray with KNO3 1% and NPK 19 : 19: 19 0. 5% at 60 DAS was found effective in increasing the dry matter production and partitioning in groundnut plant.

the foliar nutrition with KNO3 1% and KCl1% at 75 DAS and NPK 19-19-19 0.2% and KNO3 2% at 90 DAS were found to be superior for increasing the dry matter production, dry weight accumulation in stem, leaf and pods and also total dry matter partitioning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the application of foliar spray of chemical nutrients can be an effective strategy for increasing the dry matter production in groundnut under drought conditions.
foliar application of KNO3 at 0.5%, NPK 19 : 19 : 9 at 0.25% and 0.5 % and KCl at 1% significantly increased the dry matter production, partitioning and LAI in groundnut under moisture stress.
foliar nutrition can be used to mitigate the negative effects of drought on groundnut yield and yield components.
